item.description:

This is an informational change only. Customers who have successfully installed the update do not need to take any further action.

item.title: [New] KMS Hardware-Secured: KMS hosts will have to prove their hardware with TPM attestation before activating clients, mandatory from the next Windows Server LTSC
item.description:

Windows Server · Inventory KMS hosts (DNS _vlmcs SRV records), check slmgr /dlv and the Key Management Service event log for readiness warnings, and run the Key Attestation check on physical hosts.

item.description:

Windows · Query the WSL version across developer endpoints (wsl --version, or DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory) and push wsl --update where it lags.

item.title: [New] Exchange Server can become unstable after the October 2026 Windows updates; OWA may fail with MapiExceptionMdbOffline
item.description:
An Exchange outage straight after patching can look like an attack on OWA or a database failure. Knowing it is a reported post-update issue saves an incident escalation, and uninstalling a security update to cure it reopens what that update closed.

Windows Server · If you run Exchange Server on-premises and installed the October 2026 Windows updates, read the post before removing any update and watch OWA and mailbox database availability (inferred: Microsoft's remedy was not in the part of the post read here).
